Here you will find a list of hotfixes.

Hotfixes

November 13, 2026

Classes

  • Fixed a bug with diminishing returns on creature stuns.
  • Druid
    • Restoration
      • Wild Growth can no longer be cast while moving.
      • Wild Growth healing coefficient increased to 6.6% (was 3.3%).
  • Paladin
    • Judgement of Command now counts as a melee attack.
    • Developers’ notes: Other judgements stay ranged.
  • Priest
    • The Legacy Perk The Quick and the Dead now reduces the Mana cost of Divine Spirit.
  • Shaman
    • Windfury Totem is now activated by all melee abilities.
      • Developers' notes: Offhand strikes still cannot activate it.

Dungeons

  • Trivial enemies in dungeons now award no experience.
  • The Deadmines
    • Sneed now ejects properly when the Shredder is stunned.

Items

  • Taran Icebreaker now behaves as a 2-handed Mace (was 1-handed).
  • Everstaring Abomination Eye’s Spirit stats corrected.

November 11, 2026

Classes

  • Paladin
    • Judgement is now considered a Ranged Attack.
    • Retribution
      • Unsealed Fury no longer generates echoes from Windfury Totem attacks.

Quests

  • Fixed an issue with the quest "Helping Hands."
